_comment: Fixed identity/time fields, plus exactly the props any event type can carry: the union of EventMetadata_*[].eventProps across every channel metadata module (today only metadata/x.ts declares eventProps). That union is also what analytics' eventPropsFor() offers as dimensions/filters, so a column outside it would be invisible in the UI and never written. Do NOT derive this from PROPS.filter(isInsight) — that list is user/content props and produces dead columns. Enforced by analytics/tests/unit/event-stream-schema.test.ts.
